items.title: Kroger (KR) Stock May Be 34% Below Fair Value Following Data Privacy Questions
items.summary: Kroger has delivered a strong multi year share price run, and recent headlines around its data and surveillance capabilities are adding a new angle to the story. That mix of price performance and business change raises a straightforward question for you as an investor: is the current US$67.70 tag in line with the cash the supermarket group is expected to generate over time? Over the past 5 years Kroger has returned 77.0%, which puts a lot of accumulated optimism on the line if its future...
